test_title: PYST 53: SSC MTS 2024 - Reasoning Ability and Problem Solving (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Six persons P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and P6 sit around a circular table facing towards the centre (not necessarily in the same order). P2 sits second to the left of P5. One person sits between P2 and P6 when counted from the left of P2. P3 and P2 are not neighbours of P5 and P4, respectively.

Which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?

I. One person sits between P1 and P6 when counted from the right of P1.

II. P3 is an immediate neighbour of P2.
solution:
Given:

Six persons P1, P2, P3, P4, P5 and P6 sit around a circular table facing towards the centre.

P2 sits second to the left of P5.

One person sits between P2 and P6 when counted from the left of P2.

P3 and P2 are not neighbours of P5 and P4, respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8d065a7987ef7ba914748f6893ec96fc7dc5a72c7708a0f70d92c80898fd3f3d.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd256df1da174b6df4a317b58d8d4db874954e18fdb78d371ad50c9614377afb.png] 

I. One person sits between P1 and P6 when counted from the right of P1 is **wrong **statement as, 2 person sits between P1 and P6.

II. P3 is an immediate neighbour of P2, which is a correct statement.

Thus, Only II statement is correct.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
